en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 5. Ahmed ibn Ziyad ibn Ja’far al-Hamadani (ra) said, that `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, on the authority of his father, from Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Karkhi from Abu `Abdillah, from his father, from his grandfather (AS), that The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: “
Whoever dies without ascribing a partner to Allah, will enter Heaven regardless of whether he has done good or evil.”
